method.description: Read-only audit. Files were hashed, diffed (tracked) or header-inspected (untracked) without any copy, stage, rename, delete, stash or overwrite. Secret scans were count-only; no credential values were read or printed.

audit_context.canonical_tree_relation: The canonical sanitized tree descends from the same original repository. For the four tracked files, the canonical version equals the owner HEAD version for utils/setup_logger.py and differs for the other three because the phase 3-8 lineage evolved them while the owner folder carried local modifications on top of pre-phase-split code.
audit_context.dirty_state_matches_expectation: 4 modified + 6 untracked = 10 paths, matching the task brief.

dispositions.file_category: legacy Phase-0-era shadow backtest harness (Python source)
dispositions.semantic_comparison: Owner adds ~256/-67 lines on top of pre-phase-split code: reproducibility logging (_write_repro_log), structure-reset diagnostics (_patched_update_structure), and tick/period adjustments. The canonical version is the evolution of the same harness through phases 3-7 and is itself superseded by the Phase 8 frozen evaluation pipeline; the owner modifications are a parallel local experiment on the old baseline.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Both the base version and the owner variant describe the legacy shadow-mode workflow that the Phase 8 scientific-validation pipeline replaces. Migrating the owner variant would contaminate the frozen evaluation line with non-validated local logic. Preserve as-is in the owner folder.

dispositions.semantic_comparison: Owner adds a read-only property alias max_trades returning max_concurrent_trades. No behavior change; canonical does not contain the alias but computes equivalent behavior from max_concurrent_trades.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Trivial additive convenience with no semantic effect, but it touches a production module outside any authorized phase scope. Owner should decide whether to fold it into a future maintenance commit; automatic migration is not warranted.

dispositions.semantic_comparison: Owner moves the atr_val computation earlier in one branch and recomputes it later (behavior-preserving reordering; same value, same formula). The canonical version computes the identical value in its evolved structure.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Behavior-preserving local refactor with no unique value; canonical logic already produces the same market_conditions output.

dispositions.canonical_path: utils/setup_logger.py (canonical blob equals owner HEAD blob; the modification is owner-local only)
dispositions.semantic_comparison: Owner adds an optional timestamp parameter to log_setup_evaluation so logged evaluations can carry deterministic event time instead of wall-clock now(). Backward compatible; no caller changes required.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Small, additive, behavior-preserving reproducibility improvement that aligns with the Phase 8 determinism goals. Migration itself remains a separately authorized follow-up task; nothing is migrated in this checkpoint.

dispositions.semantic_comparison: Hard-codes a path to backtests/shadow_3m_rr15_phase0_with_logging/shadow_mode_trades.csv (a folder that does not exist in the canonical tree) and aggregates buy/sell PnL per period.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: One-off helper for a July 2026 manual review of Phase-0-era shadow artifacts; the Phase 8 evaluation pipeline produces equivalent summaries deterministically.

dispositions.semantic_comparison: Compares Run A vs filtered Run B trades for an Apr 17 - Jul 17 window across legacy shadow outputs; imports reference old module layout.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Legacy-window one-off comparison superseded by the frozen Phase 8 evaluation with gate/reason accounting.

dispositions.secret_privacy_classification: clean - contains simulated shadow-backtest results only, no account data
dispositions.semantic_comparison: Report dated 2026-07-30 against pre-phase-split commit 6af59c7a; documents the old engine's behavior. The canonical docs tree records the current validated line.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Historical investigation record tied to an obsolete commit; retained in the owner folder for provenance, not carried into the canonical validation line.

dispositions.semantic_comparison: StrategyState persistence audit dated 2026-07-30; the questions it investigated were later resolved by the Phase 8 checkpoint/resume verification work (deterministic interruption/resume, equivalence tests).
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Its findings are superseded by verified Phase 8 state-persistence guarantees; kept in owner folder as history.

dispositions.semantic_comparison: Standalone diagnostic capturing an HTF-bias snapshot; written against the pre-phase-split module layout. The canonical tree centralizes bias evaluation inside the validated pipeline.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Potentially useful debugging aid, but its imports target the old layout and it sits at repository root; compatibility with the canonical tree is unverified. Owner decides whether to modernize and adopt it in a maintenance task.

dispositions.secret_privacy_classification: clean of credentials; touches live broker data access by design
dispositions.semantic_comparison: Direct MT5 connectivity test. The canonical validation tree enforces a strict no-MT5/no-network import firewall (tested); introducing this file would sit against that control.
dispositions.disposition_rationale: Live-environment tool that belongs to the owner's broker machine, not to the scientific-validation codebase, whose firewall tests prohibit MT5 imports.

KEEP_AND_MIGRATE: utils/setup_logger.py (proposed only; migration requires separate authorization)

integrity_statement: No owner file was copied, staged, deleted, renamed, stashed or overwritten during this audit; no secret value was read or printed.
